_readme: Manually-maintained token unlock calendar. Free CoinGecko tiers don't expose reliable vesting data, so this stays a small hand-kept list rather than an API call. Add an entry whenever you research a coin and find a scheduled unlock - format: {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "pct_of_supply": <number>, "note": "..."}. A coin_id with no entry here simply gets unlock_risk_flag=false - that's a 'not checked' state, not a 'confirmed no unlock' state.

optimism.note: Seed Fund unlock, ~4.47M OP - small vs daily volume, low dump risk on its own
